item.title: Monday 4 PM Update, Nov 2
item.description:
The Monday 4 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 2, 2026: Londonderry weather through tomorrow, Election Day; the NTSB's first briefing on the Palm Beach County jet crash and the Justice Department's emergency Supreme Court request on California mail ballots; President Trump says there's "no rush" on Iran, and a deadly Russian strike in the Zaporizhzhia region; the Dow gains while tech slips and oil plunges; Apple's first earnings with John Ternus; a safety warning in Anthropic's IPO filing; Google breaks up a botnet of more than a million TV boxes; your X feed; New Hampshire's ballot questions and polling-place watchers; and a foundation that looks for everyday heroes.

item.title: Monday 1 PM Update, Nov 2
item.description:

item.title: Monday 10 AM Update, Nov 2
item.description:

item.title: Monday Morning, Nov 2
item.description:
The Monday morning bulletin from Gumshoe News Radio for November 2, 2026: Londonderry weather with the seven-day outlook; the final day before the midterms, all nine aboard confirmed dead in the Palm Beach County jet crash, and record flood warnings in southwest Colorado; Iran's two-day plan to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, Belgium's prime minister offers to resign, and more than 300,000 displaced in Yemen; markets rebound in premarket trading after a rough October; Apple's first earnings under its new CEO; A.I. funding jitters; hacked emergency alert apps in Ukraine and Russia and a Synology NAS ransomware warning; your X feed; New Hampshire's Senate race and Election Day reminders; and volunteers building beds for kids who've never had one. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
